title: 511 Bar & Lounge
venue_description:
511 Bar & Lounge - Flagler Village Music Venue

Venue Overview

Located in the vibrant Flagler Village neighborhood of downtown Fort Lauderdale, 511 Bar & Lounge is a modern entertainment destination featuring an expansive outdoor patio and sophisticated indoor space. Opened with a focus on showcasing local talent, the venue has become a cornerstone of Fort Lauderdale's live music scene.

Music & Events

The venue hosts weekly open mic nights every Sunday featuring musicians, poets, comedians and performers of all genres. With signups starting at 7 PM and performances running until 11:30 PM, 511 Bar & Lounge provides an welcoming stage for both established and emerging artists. Additionally, the venue hosts special monthly themed events including Jazz & Blues Nights, Country Nights, and more featuring local and regional acts.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The outdoor patio is a signature feature offering an inviting atmosphere under the stars with handcrafted cocktails and quality beverages. The venue partners with local food truck vendors, allowing guests to enjoy diverse cuisine while experiencing live performances. The space features professional sound and lighting, making it ideal for both performer and audience.

Community Focus

511 Bar & Lounge is committed to supporting local talent and fostering community connections through music. The venue attracts a diverse crowd of music enthusiasts, artists, and members of the community seeking quality entertainment in an accessible setting.

title: Island Vibes Kava Bar Fort Lauderdale
venue_description:
Island Vibes Kava Bar - Community Music & Wellness Space

Venue Overview

Island Vibes Kava Bar in Fort Lauderdale is a unique establishment combining a tropical wellness bar with a vibrant community music space. Built on the philosophy of music, art, and good vibes, the venue has become a gathering place for musicians, artists, and creatives throughout South Florida.

Music & Events

The venue hosts monthly all-arts open mic and showcase events where musicians, poets, and performers of all genres can share their work. Island Vibes welcomes rock, blues, folk, jazz, and alternative artists alongside poets and spoken word performers. The supportive community atmosphere creates an ideal environment for both experienced performers and those new to open mic nights.

Kava Bar & Wellness Culture

Island Vibes specializes in noble kava and kratom beverages crafted by knowledgeable bartenders. The kava bar culture emphasizes relaxation, community, and authentic connection. The venue maintains a chill, welcoming atmosphere that appeals to diverse age groups and backgrounds, with staff dedicated to making every visitor feel like family.

Amenities & Food

Free parking is available in an open lot for all guests. The venue features a permanent vegan food truck partnership with Caribe Vegan providing fresh, flavorful meal options. The space includes extended hours open until 2 AM, making it convenient for both early and late-night visitors seeking live music.

Community & Inclusivity

Island Vibes markets itself as a safe, inclusive space for all people including the LGBTQ community. The venue hosts various themed nights beyond open mics including yoga sessions, Latin nights, and figure drawing sessions, creating a well-rounded cultural hub for the Fort Lauderdale area.
location: 1027 North Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304

title: Kelly Brothers Irish Pub
venue_description:
Kelly Brothers Irish Pub - Historic Live Music Venue

Venue Overview

Established in 1958, Kelly Brothers Irish Pub has been a cornerstone of Fort Lauderdale's entertainment scene for over 65 years. Recently fully renovated under new management, the venue combines classic Irish pub atmosphere with state-of-the-art facilities and a commitment to supporting local musicians and artists.

Live Music & Events

Kelly Brothers hosts live music at least 3 nights per week featuring diverse genres including blues, rock, folk, and more. The venue features Wednesday All-Arts Open Mic nights where musicians, poets, comedians and performers of all genres can showcase their talent. Additionally, the venue hosts blues jam nights on Wednesdays featuring local and national recording artists. Comedy nights, karaoke, and special show performances on Saturdays round out the entertainment offerings.

Facilities & Atmosphere

The entire venue has been renovated with brand new facilities including a distinctive New Orleans-style balcony providing elevated viewing of performances. The upstairs Lounge features a private bar, pool table, ping-pong table, and large flat-screen televisions, making it ideal for private events and gatherings. The main floor maintains the classic pub feel with a welcoming, friendly atmosphere appreciated by both locals and visitors.

Food & Drinks

The pub offers classic American cuisine alongside traditional Irish fare including corned beef sliders, meatball subs, shepherd's pie, and Angus burgers. The bar stocks an extensive selection of draft beers, wines, and handcrafted cocktails. Happy Hour specials and lunch and dinner specials are regularly offered.

Location & Accessibility

Located on North Federal Highway at the corner of Oakland Park Boulevard, Kelly Brothers is easily accessible to downtown, the beach, and Fort Lauderdale airport. Ample parking is available. The venue's proximity to the airport and beach makes it convenient for both locals and travelers seeking quality live music and entertainment.
location: 3045 North Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306
